name: L9 · 我去买杯奶茶
titleEn: I'm going to buy a cup of bubble tea

title.en: Looking at pants in a store

intro.cn: 在商店，王一雪和刘明在看裤子。
intro.en: In the store, Wang Yixue and Liu Ming were looking at pants.

questions.q: 王一雪为什么想给儿子买裤子？
刘明觉得哪条裤子好看？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 儿子的裤子坏了，我们给他买条新的吧。
lines.en: Our son's pants are torn. Let's buy him a new pair.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 好啊。
lines.en: Okay.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 你看这条黑色的怎么样？
lines.en: How about this pair of black ones?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 没有你上次买的那条好看。
lines.en: They're not as nice as the ones you bought last time.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 旁边那个男孩儿就穿了这样的裤子，我觉得很好看啊！
lines.en: The boy next to us is wearing pants like these, and I think they look great!

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 儿子的个子没有他那么高，穿上就不会太好看。
lines.en: Our son isn't as tall as him, so they wouldn't look so good on him.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 好吧，我们再去那边看看。
lines.en: Alright, let's go over there and take another look.

postQuestions.q: 刘明觉得儿子穿这条裤子好看吗？为什么？
王一雪和刘明给儿子买裤子了吗？

intro.cn: 在商店门口，王一雪和刘明往外走。
intro.en: At the entrance of the store, Wang Yixue and Liu Ming were walking out.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 门口有家奶茶店。你想喝杯奶茶吗？
lines.en: There's a bubble tea shop at the entrance. Do you want a cup of bubble tea?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 我想喝咖啡，还是去咖啡店吧。
lines.en: I'd prefer coffee. Let's go to a coffee shop.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 咖啡店离这儿有点儿远。
lines.en: The coffee shop is a bit far from here.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 没关系，那家店的咖啡很好喝。
lines.en: That's fine. The coffee in that shop is very good.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 那你等一下，我去买杯奶茶。
lines.en: Then wait here for a moment while I go and buy a cup of bubble tea.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 你不想喝咖啡吗？
lines.en: Don't you want to drink coffee?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 喝了咖啡，晚上就别想睡觉了。
lines.en: I can't fall asleep if I drink coffee.

postQuestions.q: 王一雪为什么不想喝咖啡？

intro.cn: 在咖啡店门口，王一雪和刘明在聊天儿。
intro.en: At the entrance of a coffee shop, Wang Yixue and Liu Ming were chatting.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 我们打车回去吧。
lines.en: Let's take a taxi home.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 这里离家很近，还是走路吧。
lines.en: It's close to home. Let's walk.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 要走多长时间？
lines.en: How long will it take?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 走半个多小时就到了。
lines.en: Walking will take a little more than half an hour.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.cn: 好的。每天上下班都坐车，今天运动运动吧。
lines.en: Alright. I take the car to and from work every day, so I'll get some exercise today.

postQuestions.q: 王一雪为什么想走路回家？

title.en: Writing a diary in the room

intro.cn: 在房间，王一雪在写日记。
intro.en: In the room, Wang Yixue was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 判断正误：王一雪和刘明给儿子买了几件衣服。
判断正误：因为想运动，所以王一雪和刘明是走回家的。

lines.cn: 这周刘明休息，我下班后跟他去了一家商店。
lines.en: Liu Ming has the whole week off, so I went to a store with him after work.

lines.cn: 商店里边的衣服没有大商场里的好看。我们没有买到喜欢的衣服，从商店出来就到咖啡店坐了坐。
lines.en: The clothes in the store weren't as nice as those in big shopping malls. We didn't find any clothes we liked, so after leaving the store, we went to a coffee shop to sit for a while.

lines.cn: 因为想运动运动，所以喝完东西，我们就走回家了。
lines.en: Since we wanted to get some exercise, we walked home after finishing our drinks.

grammar.note: 用“没有”表示比较的比较句，意思是“不如”“不及”。基本结构：A 没有 B＋形容词或形容词性短语。形容词前面可以加“这么”或者“那么”，表示 B 的程度更高。“没有”的肯定形式“有”常用在表示比较的疑问句中。
grammar.noteEn: “没有” in comparative sentences expresses the meaning of “not as … as” or “inferior to”. Basic structure: A 没有 B + Adjective or Adjectival Phrase. The adjective can be preceded by “这么” or “那么” to indicate that B has a higher degree. The affirmative form “有” is often used in interrogative sentences to indicate comparison.

items.c: 儿子的个子没有他那么高。
items.en: Our son isn't as tall as him.
Yesterday wasn't as cold as today.

items.c: 这块手表没有那块好看。
items.en: This watch isn't as nice as that one.
Is the younger sister as tall as the older sister?

items.c: 那件衣服有这件好看吗？
items.en: Is that piece of clothing as nice as this one?

practice.cn: A：我女儿今年六岁多了，你儿子几岁了？ B：四岁多，没有____
A：这件黑色的衣服好看吗？ B：____好看，但____，还是买那件白色的吧。
A：今天____昨天那么____吗？ B：没有，我觉得昨天更热。

grammar.note: 动词“离”表示处所、时间的距离。基本结构：A 离 B……。
grammar.noteEn: The verb “离” is used to indicate spatial or temporal distance. Basic structure: A 离 B……

items.c: 咖啡店离这儿有点儿远。
items.en: The coffee shop is a bit far from here.
The school is not far from the hospital.

items.c: 现在离我的生日还有三天。
items.en: It's still three days until my birthday.

practice.cn: A：你每天都开车去上班吗？ B：是啊，公司____
A：我们酒店____。 B：太好了，我很想去商场看看。
A：____现在还有一个小时。 B：那想想下班后我们去哪儿吃饭吧。

grammar.note: 表示时间段的词语用在动词后面构成时量补语，说明动作或状态持续的时间。基本结构：主语＋动词＋时量补语。动词带宾语时，事物名词一般在时量补语后，称呼或代词一般在时量补语前；也可以重复动词后再加时量补语。动词是离合词时，需要重复动词性语素。动词后有“了”、句尾还有语气助词“了”，表示动作仍在进行。
grammar.noteEn: Time expressions are used after verbs to form complements of duration, indicating the length of time an action or a state lasts. Basic structure: Subject + Verb + Complement of Duration. If the object is a thing noun, it is usually placed after the complement; if it is a term of address or a pronoun, it is usually placed before. The verb can also be repeated before adding the complement, and a separable word repeats its verbal morpheme. With “了” after the verb and another “了” at the end, the action is still ongoing.

items.en: Walking for a little more than half an hour gets you there.
I watched TV for a whole evening.
Li Wen waited for her for an hour.

items.c: 我找了陈天中二十多分钟。
items.en: I looked for Chen Tianzhong for over twenty minutes.
They studied Chinese for two years.

items.c: 安妮游泳游了一个下午。
items.en: Annie swam for a whole afternoon.

items.c: 他写了半个小时汉字了。
items.en: He has been writing Chinese characters for half an hour.

practice.cn: A：儿子今天出去打了____。 B：这是他的爱好，一有时间就去打球。
A：你____，我去给你拿杯水来。 B：你别忙了，我说完话就回去了。
A：你的小猫找到了吗？ B：没有，我都找____。

tips.note: “动词＋到”表示动作达到了目的。
tips.noteEn: “Verb + 到” indicates that an action has achieved its purpose.

items.cn: 你女儿十多岁，____这么高啊！
咖啡店不远，我们是____过去的。
我们住的酒店____有个公交站，那儿有到火车站的公交车。
A：我也喜欢____的茶杯，你是在哪儿买的？ B：我是在公司门口那家商店买的。
A：虽然今天的工作也不少，但是我觉得没有昨天累。 B：那我们出去走一走吧。

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，商量一起旅游的出行方式，比较一下不同出行方式的优缺点。尽可能使用本课所学生词和语法。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs. Discuss travel methods for a trip and compare the advantages and disadvantages of different travel methods. Try to use the vocabulary and grammar learned in this lesson as much as possible.
